notes: One-season forecasts from 2026-07-01 by the 4-feature core LightGBM, trained on the 1000 contract samples. Caveat: those samples are survivor-biased (median training change +0.34 log, 71% rose; all panel players 2013-2025: -0.10, 32% rose), so medians lean upward. 96% of these forecasts predict a rise, median +0.94 log. Training covered ages 16-31 and values from EUR 0.75M (10th percentile); forecasts outside that range, mostly older and cheaper players, are extrapolations.
